instruction: Query the OQMD database for all stable Ni-Al binary compounds (element_set=Ni,Al AND ntypes=2), sorted by delta_e, identify the convex hull minimum and save full data to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_20.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
